register_model: register a new model class with the fairchem registry using the register_model decorator
register_task: register a new task class with the fairchem registry using the register_task decorator
register_dataset: register a new dataset class with the fairchem registry using the register_dataset decorator
get_class: get a registered class from the fairchem registry by name and mapping type
register_state: register an arbitrary key-value pair in the fairchem registry state dictionary
